result.summary: Extends the private broadcast mechanism to wallet-generated transactions and periodic wallet rebroadcasts when -privatebroadcast is enabled. Centralizes Tor and I2P availability checks into node/transaction.cpp so wallet submissions fail before mutating wallet state if private routing is unavailable. Also catches CommitTransaction exceptions in the Qt send dialog to prevent GUI crashes.
result.problem: Private transaction broadcast via short-lived Tor/I2P connections only works for sendrawtransaction, leaving standard wallet transactions and wallet rebroadcast to announce to all peers over default connections and leak the node's network identity. Furthermore, CommitTransaction failures during wallet sends can throw uncaught exceptions that crash the Qt client.
evidence: PR description: "When -privatebroadcast=1 is enabled, wallet RPCs (sendtoaddress, send, sendall, sendmany) now broadcast transactions through short-lived Tor/I2P connections instead of announcing to all connected peers."
Commit 3b3f319a42 notes that CommitTransaction() can throw std::runtime_error which sendButtonClicked() did not catch, crashing the GUI.
result.scope_notes: Touches node, wallet, Qt GUI, and test framework utilities (including SOCKS5 proxy test helpers). Note that the PR description includes an edit indicating the per-transaction persistence flag originally proposed in mapValue was dropped in favor of checking the node-level setting.
result.card: Extends private broadcast via short-lived Tor or I2P connections to wallet-created transactions and rebroadcasts when -privatebroadcast is set. Currently, wallet transactions bypass the private broadcast feature merged in #29415, announcing directly to regular peers and leaking origin metadata. The PR moves the Tor/I2P reachability check into BroadcastTransaction to abort cleanly before state changes, and adds Qt exception handling for failed wallet commits.
uncertainties: Diff is unavailable, so the exact interaction between MaybeResendWalletTxs and BroadcastTransaction cannot be verified against the commit messages.
